// Compiled only in check-intake-receiver-mutations.sh's private dependency
// copy. That copy retains the actual Open buffer; production has no hook.
package builtin

import (
	"context"
	"github.com/cloudflare/circl/hpke"
	"github.com/entire-vc/evc-keep/internal/builtin/sealer"
	"github.com/entire-vc/evc-keep/internal/intake/descriptor"
	"github.com/entire-vc/evc-keep/internal/testutil/canary"
	"testing"
)

func TestIntakePlaintextWipe(t *testing.T) {
	for _, refuse := range []bool{false, true} {
		ctx := context.Background()
		pool := testPool(t)
		seal, _ := testSealer(t, pool)
		p := New(pool, seal, sealer.Scope{Org: randID(t, "wipe-probe"), User: "alice"}, nil)
		const request = "019a0000-0000-7000-8000-000000000001"
		public, _, _, err := p.IntakeDescriptor(ctx, request, descriptor.Metadata{})
		if err != nil {
			t.Fatal("prepare wipe descriptor")
		}
		plain := []byte(canary.New().Value(1))
		defer clear(plain)
		enc, ct := intakeTestCiphertext(t, public, request, plain)
		tx, err := pool.BeginTx(ctx, readCommitted)
		if err != nil {
			t.Fatal("begin wipe probe")
		}
		if refuse {
			if _, err := tx.Exec(ctx, `DELETE FROM keep_envelope WHERE store_org=$1 AND secret_id=$2`, p.scope.Org, fpKeySecretID); err != nil {
				t.Fatal("prepare wipe refusal")
			}
		}
		hpke.IntakePlaintextProbe = nil
		_, _, _, err = p.AcceptIntake(ctx, tx, request, "wipe-target", enc, ct)
		_ = tx.Rollback(ctx)
		if (err != nil) != refuse {
			t.Fatal("wipe control did not reach intended result")
		}
		if len(hpke.IntakePlaintextProbe) != len(plain) {
			t.Fatal("wipe probe did not observe Open buffer")
		}
		for _, b := range hpke.IntakePlaintextProbe {
			if b != 0 {
				t.Fatal("intake plaintext wipe missing")
			}
		}
		hpke.IntakePlaintextProbe = nil
	}
}
